children: VNV Global AB (publ) (“VNV Global” or the “Company”) has between October 27 and October 30, 2026 repurchased 100,000 common shares, at an average price of SEK 18.5018. The Company currently holds 205,690 repurchased common shares.
The total number of common shares in VNV Global, including repurchased common shares, is 128,112,293.

VNV Global brings together patient capital and network effect businesses to achieve the scale that drives profitability over the long term. We are opportunistic investors in business models that build strong moats.
The common shares of VNV Global are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, Mid Cap segment, with the ticker VNV. For more information on VNV Global, visit
